description: This file defines the 'QueryBuilder' interface in the org.eclipse.ditto.model.query package. It specifies methods for constructing query objects, including setting sorting options, limiting result sizes, skipping elements, and building the final Query object.

classes.name: QueryBuilder
classes.description: An interface defining a builder pattern for constructing Query instances, with methods to specify sorting, size, limit, skip, and to build the query.

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Sets the sorting options for the query, overwriting any existing sort options.

methods.name: limit
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of elements to return in the query.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Alternative method to limit the number of elements returned (aliases 'limit').

methods.name: skip
methods.description: Specifies how many elements to skip at the beginning of the result set.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns the final Query object based on the configured parameters.
